description: This file defines configuration classes for different deployment environments of a Flask application, including base, development, testing, production, Heroku, Docker, and Unix configurations. It sets environment-specific settings, logging handlers, and a configuration dictionary.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Base configuration class with common settings for the Flask app, including secret key, mail server settings, and pagination options.

classes.name: DevelopmentConfig
classes.description: Development environment configuration inheriting from Config, enabling debugging and setting a local SQLite database.

classes.name: TestingConfig
classes.description: Testing environment configuration inheriting from Config, enabling testing mode and disabling CSRF.

classes.name: ProductionConfig
classes.description: Production environment configuration inheriting from Config, setting database URI, server name, and email error reporting.

classes.name: HerokuConfig
classes.description: Heroku deployment configuration inheriting from ProductionConfig, enabling SSL redirect, proxy fix, and logging to stderr.

classes.name: DockerConfig
classes.description: Docker deployment configuration inheriting from ProductionConfig, logging to stderr.

classes.name: UnixConfig
classes.description: Unix deployment configuration inheriting from ProductionConfig, logging to syslog.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Static or class method to initialize the app with environment-specific settings, such as logging handlers and proxy fix.
